label: Hook or title card
description: The hook or a title: dark words filling a white label above the head, each line sized to span the label. Tilted a touch; the opening hook (a title in the first second, or params.hook true) sits square. Uses params.text, or the spoken words of the anchor.

text.help: the words; default = the anchor's spoken words

hook.help: true = square (the opening hook); default: true only in the video's first second

tilt.help: degrees when it is not the hook

scale.help: 1.0 = as big as fits above the face
